stories.title: Missili e droni su regione di Kiev, ucciso un bambino

en.title: Missiles and drones strike Kiev region, child killed
en.summary: A child was found dead in the rubble of a residential building in Vyshgorod following missile and drone attacks on the Kiev region.

stories.title: Mosca alla Nato: "Difenderemo Kaliningrad con tutto il nostro arsenale"

en.title: Moscow to NATO: "We will defend Kaliningrad with our entire arsenal"
en.summary: Russia warned NATO following military exercises around the Kaliningrad exclave, with Moscow's foreign minister stating Europe is at war with Russia and Estonia reporting sabotage at a weapons factory.

stories.title: Cuba nella morsa della crisi: stipendi da fame, file per i contanti e medicine introvabili

en.title: Cuba caught in crisis grip: starvation wages, cash lines and unavailable medicines
en.summary: Cuba faces severe economic hardship with extremely low salaries, shortages of cash and medicines, compounded by energy restrictions and frequent blackouts affecting the population.

stories.title: La NATO mostra i muscoli attorno a Kaliningrad, Mosca: "Pronti a usare l'intero arsenale"

en.title: NATO flexes muscles around Kaliningrad, Moscow: "Ready to use entire arsenal"
en.summary: Following NATO military exercises near the Russian exclave between Poland and Lithuania, the Kremlin issued warnings to the alliance, with negotiations stalled and Russia claiming Europe is already at war.

stories.title: Guerra Ucraina - Russia, le news di oggi. Attacco aereo su Kiev, ucciso un bambino

en.title: Ukraine War - Russia, today's news. Aerial attack on Kyiv, child killed
en.summary: An aerial attack on Kyiv resulted in the death of a child.

stories.title: Di Battista torna in tv: “Ho un tumore cerebrale, i medici non mollino”

en.title: Di Battista returns to TV: "I have a brain tumor, doctors must not give up"
en.summary: Former Five Star deputy Di Battista appeared on television discussing his health condition and recovery progress.

stories.title: Di Battista: "Mi hanno asportato un tumore, ora mi devo curare"

en.title: Di Battista: "I had a tumor removed, now I must receive treatment"
en.summary: Italian political figure Di Battista announced he underwent tumor removal surgery and stated his current priority is focusing on his medical treatment rather than candidacy.

stories.title: Trump, 'da vertici big tech impegno moralmente vincolante su sicurezza IA'

en.title: Trump: 'Big tech leaders made morally binding commitment on AI security'
en.summary: Major technology company executives made commitments to Trump regarding artificial intelligence safety measures, with an agreement to implement self-regulation in the sector.

stories.title: Trump incontra i vertici Big Tech sulla sicurezza AI: "Autoregolazione e nessun controllo federale"

en.title: Trump meets Big Tech leaders on AI security: "Self-regulation and no federal control"
en.summary: Trump met with technology executives to discuss AI safety measures, with industry leaders committing to self-regulation rather than federal oversight.

stories.title: Mosca alla Nato: “Difenderemo Kaliningrad con l’intero arsenale”. Precipita bombardiere russo

en.title: Moscow to NATO: "We will defend Kaliningrad with our entire arsenal". Russian bomber crashes
en.summary: Russia threatened NATO regarding Kaliningrad while continuing military operations in Ukraine. Zelensky announced upcoming discussions on air defense and additional assistance.

stories.title: La minaccia di Putin alla Nato: “Per difendere Kaliningrad siamo pronti a usare l’atomica”

en.title: Putin's threat to NATO: "To defend Kaliningrad we are ready to use nuclear weapons"
en.summary: Moscow sent a formal letter to NATO warning of potential strikes on Western capitals, issued after EU-US military exercises near the Russian exclave.

stories.title: Di Battista torna in tv: “Ho avuto un edema per un tumore cerebrale, a Cuba mi hanno salvato”

en.title: Di Battista returns to television: "I had edema from a brain tumor, they saved me in Cuba"
en.summary: The former Five Star Movement politician discussed his hospital stay in Cuba and commented on current political issues including immigration policy and other matters.

stories.title: Auditel oltre la Tv: spot al cinema e radio on demand nel nuovo cantiere

en.title: Auditel beyond TV: cinema ads and on-demand radio in new project
en.summary: Auditel is expanding its advertising measurement technology to include cinema screenings, outdoor displays, and radio audience tracking.

stories.title: Scuola a Milano, per la Cgil servono 930 insegnanti e 526 classi in più

en.title: School in Milan, Cgil says 930 more teachers and 526 classrooms needed
en.summary: According to Cgil's research center, Milan would require at least 526 additional classrooms and 930 more teachers if applying the average student-to-classroom ratio of 20 students per class used across Lombardy.

stories.title: Miart si rinnova e rafforza il suo ruolo internazionale

en.title: Miart renews itself and strengthens its international role
en.summary: The modern and contemporary art fair at Fiera Milano has changed its name and updated its format to reinforce its connection with the city of Milan.

stories.title: Arera, bolletta elettrica +37,3% nel quarto trimestre per clienti vulnerabili

en.title: Arera, electricity bill +37.3% in fourth quarter for vulnerable customers
en.summary: The electricity bill for vulnerable customers receiving standard protection will increase by 37.3% in the fourth quarter of 2026 compared to the previous quarter, according to Arera.

stories.title: Ue: «Al vaglio misure per accessibilità economica dei carburanti»

en.title: EU: "Examining measures for fuel affordability"
en.summary: The European Commission is considering potential measures to support fuel availability and affordability for transport, addressing concerns important to many citizens.
